summary: TWO target rows, BOTH stored types CONFIRMED, zero type_corrections — and both rows resolve on the same fact, which is why animefillerguide typed both of them 'Filler' with a chapter cell of 'N/A': their source is Tite Kubo's UNNUMBERED prologue chapters, printed at the back of the tankobon and invisible to a chapter-number column. Premise re-read live: AFG row 109 'Ichigo and Rukia's Skyward Thoughts *Filler / N/A' and row 227 'Wonderful error" * Filler / N/A', both red-classed, neither carrying a minute-range note. THE CHAPTERS. bleach.fandom's episode infoboxes give ep 109 'chapters = 0.side-A the sand, 0.side-B the rotator' and ep 227 'chapters = Chapter 0.8, 0.side-A the sand, 0.side-B the rotator'. Those three are real Kubo chapters printed inside the source: en-Wikipedia's List of Bleach chapters prints volume 12's contents as '099 ... 107. Heat in Trust / 0.8. "a wonderful error"' and volume 23's as '198 ... 205. Mala Suerte! 4 / 0. "side-A the sand" / 0. "side-B the rotator"' — no mainline number on any of the three. The fandom's volume pages carry the same contents plus a reverse index ('Episodes 34 - 37 & 227' on volume 12; 'Episodes 109, 116 - 118 & 227' on volume 23), and each chapter's own section carries 'Episodes adapted from this chapter': 0.side-A -> Episodes 109 and 227; 0.side-B -> Episodes 109 and 227; 0.8 -> Episode 227 ONLY. The episode title seals 227: 「ワンダフル・エラー」 is chapter 0.8's own title, 'a wonderful error' (ja-WP's title, en-WP's chapter list). EP 109 — MIXED CONFIRMED. The episode intercuts two things. The present-day strand is the anime-original Bount arc's epilogue (Ichigo, Renji and Rukia at the Kuchiki Manor discussing Kariya; Byakuya's scolding; Yoruichi delivering the surviving Koga to Ran'Tao; Kon trying to stay behind; Ukitake on Sokyoku Hill; the group's return through the Senkaimon; Shinji Hirako arriving over Karakura) — original, significant. The flashback strand is 0.side-B and 0.side-A animated essentially in full and in the chapters' own order: Rukia's month-long Karakura assignment with Kiyone and Sentaro bickering and Ukitake offering to tell Byakuya; Renji's promotion to 6th Division lieutenant with Hinamori, Izuru and Ikkaku's 'forty years' line; Rukia stepping through the central Senkaimon on the millstone-of-fate monologue; then Keigo's Bad Shield disc, Chizuru's love test and Tatsuki's stomp, the blood splatter and the elderly Plus, the toy aeroplane, and the Dead Girl and her flowers. Roughly eight of the fandom's twenty narrative beats are that strand, and it is not decoration: the chapters' 'is fate a millstone / does history revolve' line IS the episode's title (一護とルキア、廻天する想い) and its thesis. Source significant + original significant in one episode = mixed (T28). AFL agrees ('Mixed'), and bleach.fandom's own episode table types it 'Expansion' — the class that wiki reserves for a manga-based episode enlarged with anime material — while typing the eight Bount episodes before it plain 'Filler'. Material is NEW: ep 109 (2007-01-04) is the FIRST animation of both prologue chapters; ep 227 (2009-07-07) restages them two and a half years later. EP 227 'Wonderful Error' — CANON CONFIRMED, and the whole episode is source. Beat for beat: Mizuiro's phone call to Nanako and the girlfriend's lift to school, Keigo's warnings about Ichigo and Sado, the class list, Ichigo and Sado crashing through the wall, Oshima and Sorimachi, Mizuiro introducing himself and being asked for an excuse, and the bicycle ride home = ch 0.8 end to end (its sole adaptation); the Kurosaki Clinic morning, Orihime/Tatsuki/Chizuru and Ichigo with the Plus = 0.side-A; Rukia's assignment and Renji's promotion = 0.side-B. The only non-source material is connective framing (Hinamori's report to Aizen, Hitsugaya finding Matsumoto drunk, the lieutenants' meeting used to carry the two announcements, a Karin/Yuzu beat) plus the ~1-minute 'Shinigami Zanpakuto Introductions' gag corner — the same corner the catalog already records as a divergence sitting on undisputed canon rows 190-196. Under T28's faithfulness clause that is `divergence`, not a mixed share. bleach.fandom's episode table types 227 'Normal', the class it withholds from 109 and 111. en-WP's season-12 summary is an independent restatement of the same content. BOTH ROWS ARE POSITION-LESS (A44) and neither carries a stored anchor today — correct as it stands: 0.8, 0.side-A and 0.side-B have no mainline number, ep 63 -> 183 and ep 110 -> 186 [183] fence 109, and ep 226 -> 339 and ep 267 -> 340-341 fence 227. The dissent, named: ja-Wikipedia bolds both 109 and 227 in its 各話リスト under the legend '太字のサブタイトルはアニメ版オリジナルエピソードを示す'. That marker tracks 'not part of the serialized 本編 storyline' — it leaves the Turn Back the Pendulum block (206-212) unbolded because those gaiden chapters ran in Jump, and it bolds 227 because 0.8 / 0.side-A / 0.side-B are tankobon extras. Under T25 the test is adherence to the SOURCE, and a bonus chapter printed inside the source IS the source (the GTO rule), which is exactly how Sean already ruled bleach ep 46 (side_story{-17}, mixed, A44) and eps 206-212 (side_story{-108 to -97}). ja-WP is reported, not followed. Which source lied: animefillerguide, on both rows, by reading its own empty chapter column as an absence of source.

anchor_hostile.why: A44 position-less, NOT A1 — the row is MIXED (stored type and AFL confirmed) and its source share is significant, but that share is 「0.side-A the sand」 and 「0.side-B the rotator」, two unnumbered prologue chapters printed at the back of tankobon volume 23 after ch 205 (en-WP's List of Bleach chapters (188-423) prints them as '0. "side-A the sand"' and '0. "side-B the rotator"'; bleach.fandom's volume-23 page lists the same). There is no number in the 1-479 mainline space that this row could hold, and inventing one would place ep 109 inside the Soul Society range it does not touch. The mainline line is intact without it: ep 63 -> END 183 and ep 110 -> END 186 START 183 already fence the 46-episode Bount block, so nothing is stranded. This is the ruled bleach ep-46 shape (side_story + A44), delivered as an annotation instead of a number.

A44 position-less, NOT A1 — the row is CANON (stored type and AFL confirmed) and adapts three chapters in full, but all three are unnumbered: 「0.8. a wonderful error」 printed at the back of tankobon volume 12 after ch 107, and 「0.side-A the sand」 / 「0.side-B the rotator」 printed at the back of volume 23 after ch 205 (en-WP's two chapter-list articles print all three without mainline numbers; bleach.fandom's volume pages agree and its per-chapter reverse index names Episode 227 on all three). No mainline chapter is adapted here at all, so there is no END to advance and no START to name; the surrounding fence is untouched (ep 226 -> 339 stored, and the next mainline coverage after the Zanpakuto Rebellion resumes at ch 340-341 in ep 267). Volume numbers 12 and 23 are facts about where the extras are printed, never a position.

annotations.chapters: the unnumbered prologue chapters 「0.side-A the sand」 and 「0.side-B the rotator」, printed at the back of tankobon volume 23 behind ch 205
annotations.note: weight: SIGNIFICANT — because both chapters are animated essentially in full, in their own order, and they carry the episode's thesis and its title (一護とルキア、廻天する想い, 'Ichigo and Rukia, Thoughts in the Revolving Sky' — the chapters' millstone-of-fate / does-history-revolve monologue). 0.side-B: Rukia learning of her month-long Karakura posting, Kiyone and Sentaro bickering, Ukitake seeing her off and offering to tell Byakuya, Renji's promotion to 6th Division lieutenant relayed by Hinamori with Izuru present, Ikkaku's 'forty years since you talked to her', and Rukia stepping through the central Senkaimon. 0.side-A: Keigo's Bad Shield disc argument with Mizuiro, Chizuru's love test and Tatsuki's stomp, Ichigo leaving school, the blood splatter at the telephone pole and the elderly Plus, the toy aeroplane, the Dead Girl and the flowers in the glass bottle. Roughly eight of the twenty narrative beats in bleach.fandom's episode summary. Material is NEW here: ep 109 (2007-01-04) is the FIRST adaptation of both chapters; ep 227 'Wonderful Error' (2009-07-07) restages them alongside ch 0.8. The chapters carry NO mainline number (en-WP prints them as '0. side-A' / '0. side-B' in volume 23's contents), so this row is A44 position-less by construction. The remainder of the episode is the anime-original Bount epilogue, which is why the row is mixed and not canon.

The non-source share, roughly twelve of the fandom summary's twenty beats and the entire present-day frame: the Bount arc's epilogue, which has no chapter behind it at all — Ichigo, Renji and Rukia on the Kuchiki Manor walkway arguing over Kariya's legacy until Byakuya scolds them; Yoruichi revealing she dug Go Koga out from under the ice and brought him to Ran'Tao's underground dwelling, and Ran'Tao asking to hear the last Bount's story; Ichigo catching Kon trying to sneak into Rukia's room; Ukitake finding Ichigo on Sokyoku Hill; the group's departure through the Senkaimon watched by the Gotei 13; and the closing shot of Shinji Hirako leaping over Karakura Town to set up the Arrancar arc. The prologue chapters are cut into this as flashbacks rather than told straight; the anime also swaps 0.side-A's 'Bad Shield CD' for a DVD. bleach.fandom's own episode table classes the row 'Expansion' (its manga-based-plus-anime-material class) rather than 'Filler', which is the same reading.

annotations.chapters: the unnumbered prologue chapters 「0.8. a wonderful error」 (tankobon volume 12, behind ch 107) and 「0.side-A the sand」 / 「0.side-B the rotator」 (tankobon volume 23, behind ch 205)
annotations.note: weight: SIGNIFICANT — because the three chapters ARE the episode, end to end. Ch 0.8 is animated in full and this is its SOLE adaptation (the chapter's own reverse index on bleach.fandom lists Episode 227 and nothing else; volume 12's episodes field reads 'Episodes 34 - 37 & 227', the 34-37 being ch 99-107): Mizuiro's phone call to his mother Nanako from his girlfriend's flat and his 'I don't have a mother', the lift to Karakura High, Keigo's hoodlum rumours about Ichigo and Sado, the class list for 1-3, Ichigo and Sado bursting through the wall mid-fight, Oshima and Sorimachi surrounding them, Keigo's denial and Mizuiro's calm self-introduction, Ichigo asking Mizuiro for a good excuse before saving Keigo, and the bicycle ride home ending on 'are you going to call Nanako?'. The episode's Japanese title 「ワンダフル・エラー」 is that chapter's own title. Ch 0.side-A (the Kurosaki Clinic morning, the classroom, Ichigo and the Plus) and ch 0.side-B (Rukia's Karakura posting, Renji's promotion) are also carried, but as a SECOND, fuller staging — those pages were already animated in ep 109 on 2007-01-04, so they are a DUPLICATE here, not new material; the chapters' reverse index lists Episodes 109 and 227 for both. None of the three carries a mainline number, so the row is A44 position-less. No mainline chapter is adapted in this episode at all.

The non-source share, small and connective, which is why the row stays CANON under T28's faithfulness clause rather than becoming mixed: a Soul Society framing sequence the chapters do not contain (Hinamori presenting her report to Aizen and being praised; Hitsugaya hunting for Matsumoto and finding her drunk in his office; a lieutenants' meeting used as the vehicle for announcing Renji's promotion and Rukia's posting, where 0.side-B delivers both privately), a short Karin/Yuzu 'the sky looks heavy' beat, and the roughly one-minute 'Shinigami Zanpakuto Introductions' gag corner in which Izuru introduces Rangiku's Haineko. The gag corner is the same fixture the catalog already records as a divergence on undisputed canon rows 190-196 ('Shinigami Illustrated Picture Book' / 'Arrancar Encyclopedia'), and it is weightless here for the same reason. bleach.fandom types this row 'Normal', the class it withholds from 109 and 111 ('Expansion').

structure.notes: BOTH STORED TYPES CONFIRMED — no type_corrections, deliberately; 109 stays mixed and 227 stays canon, and AFL is the label that got both right. Row identity FIRST (R20): AFG's bleach page runs 1-366+ with the TYBW tail (already split off as bleach-thousand-year-blood-war under I20); rows 105-112 and 225-229 were read by TITLE, and both target rows match ours on title and on bleach.fandom's air dates (109 = 2007-01-04, 227 = 2009-07-07, exactly the context's values). No index join was used anywhere. WHICH SOURCE LIED, and how: animefillerguide, on both rows, in the same way — its chapter column can only hold mainline numbers, both episodes adapt only UNNUMBERED tankobon prologue chapters, so the column printed 'N/A' and the class was set to red Filler. The 'N/A' is honest about the number; the red class reads an empty column as an absence of source. This is the third instance of this exact shape in the catalog (bleach ep 46's bonus ch -17, soul-eater ep 32's vol-9 bonus chapter, and these two) and it will keep producing strong-tier contradictions that resolve as 'canon or mixed, A44 position-less'. THE DISSENT, stated: ja-Wikipedia's BLEACH (アニメ) 各話リスト bolds both 109 and 227, under the legend '太字のサブタイトルはアニメ版オリジナルエピソードを示す' (bold = anime-original episode), sourced to the official 'BLEACH ANIMATION BEST' page. That marker tracks 'outside the serialized 本編 storyline' rather than 'not from Kubo': the same table leaves 206-212 (Turn Back the Pendulum) unbolded because those gaiden chapters ran in Jump, and bolds 227 because 0.8 / 0.side-A / 0.side-B are tankobon extras. Under T25 the standing is measured against the SOURCE, and a side story printed inside the source IS the source (the GTO ruling), which is how Sean already ruled ep 46 (bonus ch -17: mixed + side_story + A44) and eps 206-212 (side_story{-108 to -97}). ja-WP is reported and not followed; if Sean prefers the ja-WP reading, the consequence is not a retype of these two rows alone but a re-ruling of ep 46 and 206-212 with them. CHAPTER SPACE: unchanged. This entry's scope is mainline 1-479 and neither row touches it; the three prologue chapters are named as titles, never converted to numbers (the N22 convention — 0.8's digits are inside a quoted title so no parser can read them as a chapter). SOURCES BEYOND AFL AND AFG: (1) bleach.fandom via the MediaWiki API — the two episode pages, the Episodes list page (its per-row Normal / Expansion / Filler class), and the volume pages MALA SUERTE! (vol 23) and FLOWER ON THE PRECIPICE (vol 12) with their per-chapter summaries, character lists and 'Episodes adapted from this chapter' reverse index. (2) en-Wikipedia — List of Bleach chapters (1-187) and (188-423) for the printed volume contents, and Bleach season 5 / season 12 for independent per-episode summaries. (3) ja-Wikipedia BLEACH (アニメ) for the Japanese titles, the air dates and the (dissenting) original-episode marker.
structure.coverage_set_checked: ep 63 -> END 183; eps 64-108 = the Bount arc, filler; ep 109 = 0.side-A + 0.side-B (first adaptation) inside the Bount epilogue, position-less; ep 110 -> END 186 START 183. ep 226 -> END 339 START 338; ep 227 = 0.8 (sole) + 0.side-A / 0.side-B (re-staged), position-less; eps 228-266 = the Zanpakuto Rebellion, filler; ep 267 resumes at ch 340-341. No mainline chapter is stranded by leaving either row position-less, and no stored anchor moves.

flags_for_sean: A COVERAGE FACT the catalog cannot currently express, and it is now proven on two rows: bleach.fandom's volume-12 and volume-23 pages carry a reverse index for the three prologue chapters, and it says 0.8 is adapted ONLY by ep 227 while 0.side-A and 0.side-B are adapted by ep 109 AND ep 227. Because both rows are A44 position-less, a reader has no way to learn from the catalog that ep 227 is where ch 0.8 lives — the side_story annotations are the only carrier. If the asterisk UI ever surfaces side_story chapters as findable text, these are the rows to test it on.

ja-Wikipedia's bleach original-episode marker DISSENTS on both target rows (it bolds 109 and 227). I did not follow it, because following it would contradict Sean's own 2026-09-04 ruling on ep 46 (bonus chapter -17 = side_story, mixed, not filler) and the 206-212 side_story ruling. Flagging it explicitly so the decision is Sean's and not mine by omission: if a tankobon bonus chapter is to count as source, these two rows are canon/mixed as stored; if it is not, ep 46 and 206-212 have to move with them.

bleach.fandom's Episodes page carries a per-row TYPE column (Normal / Expansion / Filler) that is independent of AFL and AFG and that agreed with our stored types on both target rows and on their neighbours (105-108 Filler, 109 Expansion, 110 Normal, 111 Expansion; 225-227 Normal, 228-229 Filler). It is a cheap third typing witness for the remaining bleach rows and is not currently in the source list.
